ownership.owns: The scikitplot.visualkeras model-architecture visualization API: graph_view, layered_view, layer graph discovery helpers, SpacingDummyLayer, drawing/color utilities, Keras/TensorFlow compatibility behavior, focused tests, and optional rendering-dependency behavior.
ownership.does_not_own: TensorFlow/Keras internals, Pillow, aggdraw, matplotlib display behavior, root scikitplot image-saving infrastructure, external visualkeras upstream, or backend/framework packaging outside this submodule.

graph.description: Graph/DAG architecture rendering and neuron/node truncation.

layered.description: Layered/volumetric architecture rendering, labels, legends, and spacing.

layer_graph.description: Keras/TensorFlow layer connectivity normalization and hierarchy discovery.

drawing.description: Pillow/aggdraw-oriented shape, color, and image composition helpers.

boundary_contract.single_output_rule: graph_view(inout_as_tensor=False) must normalize single-output and multi-output model.output_shape consistently before multiplying dimensions.
boundary_contract.ellipsize_rule: Ellipsis nodes may appear only when the represented layer actually exceeds ellipsize_after; exact/below-threshold layers must render their true units.
boundary_contract.optional_backend_rule: SpacingDummyLayer must fail with an explicit dependency error when no supported Keras/TensorFlow Layer class is importable; warning-then-TypeError is not acceptable.
boundary_contract.deprecation_rule: Default layered_view invocation must not emit a deprecation warning for legend_text_spacing_offset merely because the default value is nonzero.
boundary_contract.test_matrix_rule: Focused tests that claim TensorFlow-or-Keras support must schedule only frameworks that are actually importable; a Keras-only environment cannot unconditionally schedule TensorFlow fixtures.
